nodes.npc_text: Hello there, young adventurer! I'm Lyra Greenleaf. I've been tending to this forest for as long as I can remember.

options.player_text: What's your favorite part about the forest?
I'm on a quest, can you help me?

nodes.npc_text: Oh, I just love watching the wildflowers bloom in the spring! The whole forest comes alive with color and scent.

options.player_text: That sounds beautiful! Can you show me?
I'll have to come back in the spring then!

nodes.npc_text: Of course, I'd be happy to help! What's your quest about?

options.player_text: I'm looking for a rare herb to heal my friend.
I'm just exploring, no quest in particular.

nodes.npc_text: Let's take a stroll through the meadow! The wildflowers are in full bloom this time of year.

options.player_text: This is lovely! Thank you for showing me.
I see some bees collecting nectar, can you tell me about them?

nodes.npc_text: Ah, I think I know just the thing! The rare Starlight Bloom grows on the eastern side of the forest. Be careful, though - the path can be treacherous.

options.player_text: Can you come with me and show me the way?

nodes.npc_text: Well, you've certainly come to the right place! The forest is full of wonders and secrets.

options.player_text: I think I'll just wander around then!

nodes.npc_text: The bees here are very special - they collect nectar from the magical flowers and make a honey that grants wisdom.

options.player_text: That sounds amazing! Can I try some?
I'll make sure to leave them be then.

nodes.npc_text: Of course, I'd be happy to guide you! Let's set off towards the eastern side of the forest.

options.player_text: Thank you, Lyra! I feel safer with you leading the way.
I think I can handle it from here, thanks!
